decisions.reason: As a multi-item men’s line in a narrow portfolio, it likely has higher carrying costs and by 2022 the uncertainty should be largely resolved, so with only launch evidence and no later visible support it is prudent to abandon it.

This cleansing foam fits very closely with the firm’s established natural skincare range, likely costs relatively little to keep as an option, and its complementary role in an existing series supports continuing it despite limited public evidence.
